Position: Consultant - Education
Employment type: Fixed Term Contract
Location: Bangalore/Mumbai
About Sattva
We Partner to deliver social impact at scale
Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale.
We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory & orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.
Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in 
About the Team
Foundation team’s core objective is to be strategic advisors to domestic and global foundations to achieve orbit shifting impact. Our focus is on enabling holistic organisation and ecosystem transformation - by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound and effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged and their interests are covered.
The Opportunity
As a Consultant in the Foundations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact. As a Consultant, you will get an opportunity to work alongside individuals/teams on research, design, delivery, ecosystem engagement and business growth.
Key responsibilities
Project Management
-- Independently build simple project plans and manage daily responsibilities efficiently.
-- Actively track project milestones and manage multiple streams within the project to ensure execution as per timelines.
-- Possess excellent time management and prioritisation skills to work on key activities directly linked to impact outcomes.
-- Proactively identify and report project-related risks, mitigating them in consultation with the project lead.
-- Maintain comprehensive documentation of key project knowledge assets, ensuring all critical information is well-documented and easily accessible.
Stakeholder Engagement
-- Build credibility and influence with the middle management of client organisations, relevant stakeholders in the education ecosystem through proactive engagement and demonstrated experience.
-- Actively engage with clients, comprehending both articulated and unarticulated needs.
-- Articulate your perspective by leveraging pertinent information, compelling arguments, and illustrative examples.
Team Collaboration
-- Work with junior team members, guide Associate or Analysts on the team to achieve high-quality project deliverables on time; Able to give and receive constructive feedback to the team members in a respectable manner.
-- Collaborate with senior stakeholders of the organisation, actively contributing innovative ideas and frameworks as needed to support business growth initiatives.
-- Manage conflict within the team in an open and transparent manner.
Strategic Thinking & Problem solving
-- Stay updated on trends in the education ecosystem and actively build perspectives, frameworks, and mental models that strengthen strategic thinking.
-- Structure problem statements and support the development of evidence-backed, contextually grounded strategic recommendations.
-- Understand the broader vision of the organisation/project and align workstreams accordingly.
-- Take a step back periodically to identify emerging insights or patterns that may influence project work.
Research & Data Analysis
-- Lead primary and secondary research (proficiency in literature review, market research, solution landscape mapping , policy research, etc.).
-- Prepare interview questions for primary research, manage focus groups, carry out interviews and conduct surveys.
-- Conduct relevant quantitative/qualitative analysis on the data to cull out meaningful insights relevant to client problems.
-- Present data insights in a concise and meaningful manner using relevant visualisations.
Key qualifications and experiences:
-- 4–6 years of experience in consulting, project management, operations, research in the corporate sector, social sector, or global foundations.
-- MBA or an equivalent postgraduate degree in business management, development studies, public policy, education, or social sciences.
-- Prior experience in the education sector including experience with education programs, research, evaluations, policy analysis, or similar work.
-- Experience working with government school systems, state education departments, or education-focused foundations/NGOs is required.
-- Prior experience in a client- or customer-facing role is preferred.
-- Experience in leading small teams and contributing to program strategy is an added advantage.
-- Willingness to work closely with field teams and travel to project sites as required.
-- Proficiency in regional languages (Odiya/Hindi/Kannada) is an added advantage.
-- Demonstrate humility, willingness to listen, and eagerness to learn.
We cultivate a supportive and inclusive work environment for all our employees and reinforce diversity in our workplace. All applications regardless of race, religion, caste, color, place of origin, gender, sexuality, disability, and age will be welcome and will be fairly evaluated as per the requirements of the role.
Why Sattva?
It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
-- Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design
-- Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment
-- Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can
-- Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow
How to Prepare?
This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.

2-4 years of experience in consulting, research, project management, stakeholder management in corporate, social enterprises, consulting firms or global foundations

Position: Research Analyst, Cybersecurity
Department: Growth Opportunity Analytics
Employment type: Full-Time
Location: Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

Location: Selangor or Iskandar, Johor

The Opportunity

The Security division of Frost & Sullivan provides organisations with up-to-date market intelligence that enables our clients to take advantage of the rapid pace of technology and business model evolution in global markets. Every company around the globe is impacted by Security challenges; when combined with the power of Frost & Sullivan’s vertical market practices, the Asia-Pacific Security team provides clients with differentiated market intelligence that delivers both vendor and end-user insights.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for Market Research Analyst professional to play a key role in the growth of the cybersecurity market research and consulting team in APAC. This is a thought leadership position that requires the candidate to help build our business practice by developing insightful strategic research and proactively supporting client engagements, business development, and team building initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Expertise– Become a core member of the cybersecurity market research team, delivering value via strategic research, client engagement, and social media outreach.

Intellectual Property and Strategic Evaluation –
Develop powerful, actionable strategic recommendations, and insightful, up-to-date market intelligence based on a profound understanding of the cybersecurity industry, technologies, and services that security vendors sell into the enterprise market.

Business Development –
Maintain strong business relationships via proactive outreach to security vendors across APAC, regularly participate in briefings with security vendors, conduct detailed business needs analysis for Frost & Sullivan clients, and ensure the translation of client strategic business needs into one or more Frost & Sullivan research solutions.

Consulting Engagement – Contribute to cybersecurity consulting projects and utilise defined market research and analytical practices in a team-focused environment.

Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate and an enthusiastic curiosity about the critical role cybersecurity plays in enabling businesses in every industry across APAC. A proactive, methodical, and innovative – thinking outside the box – working practice is essential, with the ability to deliver accurate, high impact results in a fast-paced team-focused environment.

Essential

An analytical thought process, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills and business level fluency in English.

The organisational skills and ability to develop a coherent story about what is happening in a market.

An understanding of consulting/research/investigative journalism methodologies and business modelling (primary/secondary research, strategy development/implementation/coherent story development, and consulting best practices/processes).

Fast learner who can quickly demonstrate understanding of the Security industry, its structure, operational practices, business functionalities, and competitive landscape.

Desire and enthusiasm to build expertise in the cybersecurity domain.

Ability to proactively forge and maintain security vendor relationships.

Commercially astute enthusiasm for supporting the company’s business development initiatives

Aspiration to become a public speaker with the ability to interactively present to an executive audience and defend the research and its conclusions in a professional manner.

A team player with a deep understanding about why collaboration is the key to business success, an ability to work across all of Frost & Sullivan’s industry practices in a collaborative fashion to deliver our unique cross vertical market intelligence and consulting solutions.

A degree level education or equivalent experience within a relevant related discipline, e.g.:

Journalism, business administration, sociology, anthropology, psychology, market research, market intelligence, or consulting.

Desirable

A relevant post graduate qualification (MA, MBA) or equivalent experience, e.g.:

Market intelligence, market research analyst, consulting, or journalism focused on business issues, advisory services, and/or consulting.

Previous experience in a market/industry research role.

Familiar with cybersecurity concept and market landscape, particularly in the areas of cloud/ application, data security and cybersecurity services.

Career Progression

We believe in career progression. We therefore invest in training and career development, with defined career paths available to those who demonstrate higher levels of success.

If you are interested in working in an international, fast paced, dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding team player environment and you meet the requirements of this role, please forward your CV and cover letter outlining your suitability for the position to the email box provided.

Only successful applicants will be contacted for interview.

You must be eligible to work in the Malaysia for any employer.

jd_text:
Position: Senior Consultant - Marketing Analytics
Req ID: SR-46751
Location: New York; California (remote)
Employment type: Full time

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Fractal Analytics is a strategic AI partner to Fortune 500 companies with a vision to power every human decision in the enterprise. Fractal is building a world where individual choices, freedom, and diversity are the greatest assets. An ecosystem where human imagination is at the heart of every decision. Where no possibility is written off, only challenged to get better. We believe that a true Fractalite empowers imagination with intelligence. And that it will be such Fractalites that will continue to build the company for the next 100 years.

Please visit Fractal | Intelligence for Imagination for more information about Fractal.

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Marketing Analytics / Decision Science Consultant to join our team on an urgent basis. This role requires strong expertise in marketing analytics, data-driven decision-making, and campaign performance optimization. The ideal candidate should be able to quickly onboard and drive impact within a fast-paced environment.
Fulltime role
Location: Remote (EST time zone preferred)
Key Responsibilities
Analyse and optimize ROI of marketing campaigns across channels
Perform analysis on user app data to identify whales in the add mobs ecosystem and do the right kind of recommendations for retention and increasing revenue from such app partners
Work closely with the leaders and senior analysts on the paid media side for ad mobs and figure out strategies and analyses to help with the program which focuses on increasing revenue from prime customers in the ecosystem
Ambiguity and scoping skill in defining measurement gap structuring minimum viable measurement approaches and translating high level business priorities into structured analytical roadmaps
Monitor and evaluate key performance metrics, including:Campaign activations
Revenue generation
Overall campaign performance

Conduct deep-dive analysis on social media campaigns and performance metrics
Build insights and actionable recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency
Leverage data to support strategic decision-making
Required Expertise
Strong background in Marketing Analytics / Decision Science (mandatory)
Funnel and cohort analysis ability to build and measure unmanaged and managed setup funnels survival rate benchmarks and retention tenure tracking baselines
Campaign attribution and reporting experience developing tracking mechanisms for lifecycle marketing campaigns to evaluate Roy investment adjustments and campaign influence on partner adoption
Strong understanding of partner lifetime value addressable publisher churn reduction and revenue impact analysis tracking in-yard captured revenue and time-to-live
Hands-on experience in:Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) and Long-Term Attribution (LTA)
Funnel Analytics
Campaign Analytics
ROI analysis across marketing and social media channels

Technical Skills
Data extraction and infrastructure proficiency in querying and working with large-scale product data tables tracking setup to activation drivers and navigating complex data environments such as product data tables and internal bi systems
Proficiency in working with and setting up agenting workflows using clients first-party agenting tools
Proficiency in:SQL
Advanced Excel

Strong understanding of statistical and analytical techniques, including:Correlation
Regression
Forecasting
Segmentation

Experience with the these skills as:AdMob
AdSense

Soft Skills
Cross-functional collaboration ability to partner closely with product analyst engineers
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Highly adaptable, flexible, and eager to learn
Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment
Ideal Candidate Profile
Consultant with strong Decision Science / Marketing Analytics background
Proven experience working on data-driven marketing strategies
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights

Pay: 
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.  The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.  At Fractal, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.  A reasonable estimate of the current range is: $100,000 to $120,000. In addition, for the current performance period, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus.

Benefits:
As a full-time employee of the company or as an hourly employee working more than 30 hours per week, you will be eligible to participate in the health, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability plans in accordance with the plan documents, which may be amended from time to time. You will be eligible for benefits on the first day of employment with the Company. In addition, you are eligible to participate in the Company 401(k) Plan after 30 days of employment, in accordance with the applicable plan terms. The Company provides for 11 paid holidays and 12 weeks of Parental Leave. We also follow a "free time" PTO policy, allowing you the flexibility to take time needed for either sick time or vacation.

Fractal provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit?  Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
